thesis: I propose a portable architecture loop whose recommendation, paper and slides share the same evidence and decisions.
tension: A polished publication can still lack a defensible choice or contain contradictions.
recommendation: Pilot the file-based loop for substantial recurring work; keep simpler methods for smaller tasks.
decision_ask: Select one representative architecture brief, a checklist baseline and explicit acceptance criteria for a bounded comparison.
running_example: A source correction invalidates a pivotal capability claim after the draft is written.

glossary.Canonical record: The authoritative record from which other artifacts are derived
glossary.Fingerprint: A hash identifying the exact current canonical bytes
glossary.Semantic review: A substantive assessment of meaning, evidence and decision quality
glossary.Idempotency: Whether repeating an operation changes its effect

beats.takeaway: Shared records can make the recommendation reviewable.
I derive the loop from explicit invariants.
Documented adapters provide a starting point; live host behavior still needs validation.
The process must earn its overhead against simpler options.
The host performs the intellectual work; files retain its evidence.
Changed evidence must propagate into both publications.
Both formats must preserve the same conditions.
I would adopt only after a bounded comparison.
The decision is to pilot within explicit limits.
